name: signalk-forecast-verify
description: Signal K web app comparing measured WMO wind and gust with forecasts from many weather models (ECMWF, NOAA GFS, ICON, AROME, UKMO and more)

scripts.build: mkdir -p public/vendor && cp lib/verify.js public/verify.js && cp node_modules/chart.js/dist/chart.umd.min.js node_modules/chart.js/LICENSE.md public/vendor/ && mv public/vendor/LICENSE.md public/vendor/chart.js-LICENSE.md
